director_name.description: Name of the backup director (server) allowed to control this client. Must match the Director resource name in the server config.

director_port.description: Port on which the Director listens for connections from this File Daemon (typically 9101).

director_password.description: Password for authenticating the Director to this File Daemon. Should be a strong, unique secret.

fd_name.description: Name of this File Daemon (client). Should be unique across your backup infrastructure.

fd_port.description: Port on which this File Daemon listens for connections from Directors (default: 9102).

working_dir.description: Directory for spooling backup data and storing state files. Must be writable by the bacula-fd process.

pid_dir.description: Directory where the bacula-fd process writes its PID file.

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum number of simultaneous backup/jobs allowed. Higher values increase parallelism but CPU/memory usage.

fd_address.description: Network address (IP or hostname) this File Daemon binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for Director-FD communication (recommended in production for security).

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate file for verifying TLS connections (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to this File Daemon's TLS certificate (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key_file.description: Path to this File Daemon's TLS private key (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_verify_peer.description: If true, strictly verify the Director's certificate against the CA (recommended for security).

tls_cipher_list.description: OpenSSL cipher list for TLS negotiation. Adjust for compliance or legacy compatibility.

console_name.description: Name of the local console resource used by `bconsole` to connect locally (for administration).

console_password.description: Password for the local console (bconsole). Should match the Console resource in the Director.

console_commands.description: List of commands the console is allowed to execute. Restrict to least-privilege as needed.

extra_directors.description: Additional Directors allowed to connect (e.g., for failover or multi-server setups).

name.description: Unique name for the extra Director.

password.description: Director's password (must match Director resource on server).

storage_daemon.description: Optional Storage Daemon definition for direct client→SD communication (rare; most traffic goes Director→Client→SD).

name.description: Storage Daemon name (must match its SD resource).

address.description: IP or hostname of the Storage Daemon.
